name: Renal Loaf
labelNotes: Royal Canin says to feed it under your vet's supervision, and it can be fed for life. The label recommends a full health check every 6 months.
Keep fresh water available at all times.
Amounts are from the Normal weight column, read at your dog's target weight.
Mixing with Renal dry, the label gives for a normal-weight dog: 5 kg 50 g dry + 103 g wet; 10 kg 70 g + 205 g; 20 kg 176 g + 205 g; 30 kg 183 g + 410 g; 40 kg 268 g + 410 g.

source.notes: Owner's can (Australia), feeding guide photo, plus Royal Canin Australia's Renal Loaf page. Energy: the label and the AU page both give metabolisable energy 1586 kcal/kg = 158.6 kcal/100 g. adultGuide is the NORMAL weight-condition column in grams from the AU page's table (2–80 kg). The owner's label gives the same column in cans (410 g): 1/2, 1, 1 1/2, 2, 2 1/2 cans for 5, 10, 20, 30, 40 kg (205, 410, 615, 820, 1025 g); those are the page's grams rounded to the nearest quarter can (e.g. 30 kg: 848 g ≈ 2 cans). The owner asked for grams rather than can fractions, so the page's exact grams are used. Label's other columns, cans: THIN 1/2, 1, 1 3/4, 2 1/4, 3; OVERWEIGHT 1/2, 3/4, 1 1/4, 1 3/4, 2 1/4. Mixed row (Renal dry g + cans) is the same as on the Renal dry label.
